insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $961,274, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,200,768 to $9,200,768, a 1x increase.
